q: What does the free audit cover?
a: The audit is a 30 minute walkthrough of how your whole business runs, from operations and admin to sales, retention and management. For each area we note who does the work, what tool they use, and whether it runs on its own, depends on someone remembering, or is where time and customers slip away. You leave with a clear map of your business, a list of the leaks we found, and an estimate of what each one costs you every month, whether or not you work with us.

q: What kinds of tasks can your AI systems handle?
a: Anything repetitive that costs you time or customers: answering and returning calls, following up on leads and quotes, booking, reminders, asking for reviews, reaching past customers, back-office admin, and custom systems and CRM built around your workflow. Alex, our speed-to-lead caller, is live today. Every other system is scoped on your audit.

q: How long does it take to get my AI system live?
a: Alex is live within 14 days of kickoff, with appointments already booking. If we miss that, that month's fee is waived. Timelines for other systems and the full AI overhaul are agreed on your audit.

q: Will AI automation disrupt my current operations?
a: No. Your AI systems fill the gaps your team can't cover, like after hours calls, overflow, and follow ups. We build around the tools you already use, test everything before launch, and handle the whole setup for you.

Our first 3 founding clients pay $6,500 for setup plus 3 months fully managed, then $1,500 a month locked in. After that the standard package is $10,000 for setup plus 3 months, then $2,000 a month. All software is included and there are no per-minute charges. Other systems and the full AI overhaul, including on-site days, are scoped on your audit and custom-priced.
